description: Added 2026-10-04 to validate the existing historical frozen config; not its original schema.

authorization.const: User: plan and execute the next complete-unit100M comparison, report and commit, stop before5B/Chat.

const.definition: Complete Japanese sentence/paragraph units define new records with EOS; original article EOS position is not retained
const.conservative_predicate_end: Reject nominal fragments, heading lines of any length and table markers; all internal nonempty lines must have complete predicate endings

initial_state.const: Same completed2B weights/Adam/RNG/Web cursor, explicit equal peakLR0.002 fork,2900 stable+152 decay updates. Both100M controls are new; preserve old25M.

sampler.const: Deterministic evenly distributed whole short batches; unchanged BlockSampler for each source; separate web/short cursors, route position and EOS/input counters saved at completed updates

resume_gate.const: CUDA continuous4 versus2+save+resume2; two short/two web updates including stable-to-decay schedule boundary, all optimizer/scheduler/RNG/sampler/history exact

conditional_full_evaluation.const: Web if screen has no major regression; short only if all fixed adoption gates pass. At most2full89416-dev/400-output evaluations; supplementary suite does not replace fixed.

completion.const: Both100M arms, original fixed comparisons plus frozen auxiliary diagnostics, eligible full evaluations, review evidence/report/commit. Stop before5B/Chat/sweeps. Failed improvement completes experiment, not model quality.

avoid_redundant_validation.const: Reuse accepted builder/loader policy and original corpus manifests. New short stream checksum and actual CUDA save/resume are required; no repeated full corpus/index audit.

preserved_preparation.const: Initial and r1 CPU-only pools and evidence retained. r1 evenly-spaced sample exposed long heading/table markers missed by first refinement. Final conservative filter revised before training; zero GPU training/inference in either discarded preparation.
